dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the federal government and one private entity, Big Winnie Land and Timber, LLC.
dimensions.evidence: convey to BWLT all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land

dimensions.assessment: Transfers specific property parcels totaling about 17.5 federal acres and 36.7 non-federal acres.
dimensions.evidence: the approximately 17.5 acres of Federal land in Itasca County, Minnesota

dimensions.assessment: Requires cash equalization payments if values differ, and requires the private entity to cover all closing and survey costs.
dimensions.evidence: BWLT shall pay all closing costs associated with the exchange

dimensions.assessment: Applies a targeted legislative land exchange and subsequent management under forestry laws for a specific location.
dimensions.evidence: The non-Federal land acquired by the United States under subsection (a) shall be added to, and managed as part of, the Chippewa National Forest

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land ownership, with the exchange required to occur not later than 1 year after the offer.
dimensions.evidence: if BWLT offers to convey the non-Federal land to the United States, the Secretary shall, not later than 1 year after the date on which such offer is made--accept the offer

missing_information: Appraised monetary values of the federal and non-federal land parcels
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes a specific land exchange of approximately 17.5 acres of federal land for approximately 36.7 acres of non-federal land in Itasca County, Minnesota, under specified conditions.
